title: Settings control shape
question: Replace every settings toggle on event + recurring event Settings with an icon button that shows On / Off (grey when off, coloured when on). How should that control sit in the row?

options.label: Keep rows · status chip right
options.thesis: Title + description stay on the left. The switch becomes a compact icon + On/Off button on the right — same scan path, clearer state.
options.viewport: Pause registration · description · [🎫 Off]   Enable payments · description · [💳 On]
options.risk: Less like the Luma tile reference; denser list stays familiar.

options.label: Icon tiles · name + status
options.thesis: Each setting becomes a tappable tile: coloured icon well + setting name + On/Off subtitle. Descriptions move to aria or a quieter line under the grid.
options.viewport: Grid of tiles like your reference — Registration / Open, Booking approval / On — greyed when Off.
options.risk: Loses the explanatory subcopy unless we keep a small hint under each tile; busier on long lists.

options.label: Tiles for Registration · chips elsewhere
options.thesis: Registration group becomes a horizontal/wrapping tile strip. Checkout, Visibility, Limits keep title + description with status chips.
options.viewport: Top: tile strip. Below: familiar preference rows with icon On/Off chips.
options.risk: Two control languages on one Settings tab.
